state: snapshot preserved; execution canceled; continuation pending

observations: The experiment runner was in uninterruptible kernel wait (D state), with wait channel uvm_gpu_release and no log or CPU-time progress.
A single bounded nvidia-smi diagnostic produced no output; its Slurm step failed to terminate cleanly.
Slurm drained the node with a Kill task failed reason for that diagnostic step.
The experiment step was canceled and the run flock was released. Kernel-side cleanup on the drained node was not confirmed complete.
No GPU reset or node configuration change was attempted.
The root cause is unresolved; the evidence does not distinguish a device fault from a driver/runtime interaction.
